title: Proof Gradient
canonical_line: One agent tries. Proof decides. The network evolves.
doctrine: No proof, no evolution. No eval, no propagation. No rollback, no release.

systems.name: Artifact Vault
systems.meaning: Versioned Direction, Strategy, Capability, Policy, Eval, Context, Routing, Approval, and Release artifacts.

systems.name: Run Fabric
systems.meaning: Large deterministic agent institutions resolve artifacts, run, emit proof, and coordinate across sovereign domains.

systems.name: Proof Ledger
systems.meaning: Append-only evidence: traces, evals, scores, credit assignment, prices, routes, canaries, rollbacks, and claim boundaries.

systems.name: Selection Gate
systems.meaning: Candidates must beat baselines, pass policy gates, preserve sovereignty, route through canary, and keep rollback targets.

proofs.title: Proof #1 — Sovereign Swarm
proofs.subtitle: A deterministic large multi-agent coordination lattice.

proofs.title: Proof #2 — Evolution Tournament
proofs.subtitle: Candidates compete against baselines; only proven artifacts earn canary.

proofs.title: Proof #3 — Recursive Evolution Ladder
proofs.subtitle: Selected artifacts become the next baseline; unsafe evolution is rejected and rolled back.

proofs.title: Proof #4 — Corporate RSI Dominion
proofs.subtitle: A deterministic corporate-domain RSI system for the AI-first enterprise era.

proofs.title: Proof #5 — Enterprise RSI Superorganism
proofs.subtitle: A deterministic AI-first corporate operating system that recursively improves enterprise value-creation artifacts.

proofs.title: Proof #6 — Sovereign Enterprise Constellation
proofs.subtitle: A deterministic network of AI-first sovereign enterprises recursively improving through federation, proof markets, selection, and rollback.

proofs.title: Proof #7 — Sovereign Enterprise Proof Economy
proofs.subtitle: A deterministic proof market where sovereign enterprises price, route, adopt, reject, and compound reusable intelligence.

proofs.title: Proof #8 — Sovereign Domain Atlas
proofs.subtitle: A deterministic institutional RSI atlas across sovereign domains.

proofs.title: Proof #9 — Sovereign Kardashev Capital Engine
proofs.subtitle: A deterministic capital–compute–energy RSI engine for sovereign domains, framed as a Kardashev-scale scenario laboratory with strict proof and claim boundaries.

evidence.positioning: AI-first sovereign-domain RSI engine for capital, compute, energy, trust, markets, infrastructure, and governance
evidence.vision_quote: A superintelligent machine would be of such immense value, with so much wealth accruing to any company that owned one, that it could allow us to reach Kardashev Type II civilization level.
evidence.claim_boundary: All value, price, reputation, capital, compute, energy, trust, and Kardashev values are deterministic synthetic scenario units, not dollars, not revenue, not profit, not watts, and not investment advice.

goals_used.name: Sovereign Kardashev Direction
goals_used.explains: Frames Kardashev-scale ambition as a proof-bounded scenario, not an achieved fact.

goals_used.name: Capital Compounding Goal
goals_used.explains: Routes synthetic capital toward proof-backed sovereign domains.

goals_used.name: Compute Sovereignty Goal
goals_used.explains: Allocates synthetic compute to domains where evaluation evidence supports expansion.

goals_used.name: Energy Leverage Goal
goals_used.explains: Models energy leverage as a synthetic infrastructure-readiness signal.

goals_used.name: Sovereignty Integrity Goal
goals_used.explains: Ensures that shared intelligence is generalized, redacted, eval-backed, and rollbackable.

plans_used.name: Capital–Compute–Energy Flywheel Plan
plans_used.explains: Coordinates capital, compute, energy, and trust routing through proof-backed selection.

plans_used.name: Kardashev Scenario Governance Plan
plans_used.explains: Prevents ambitious civilization-scale language from becoming unsupported factual claims.

plans_used.name: Sovereign Domain Routing Plan
plans_used.explains: Routes generalized artifact patterns across sovereign domains without sharing private data.

plans_used.name: Meta-RSI Upgrade Plan
plans_used.explains: Improves the improvement machinery itself: eval generators, pricing, routing, credit assignment, and rollback predictors.

skills_used.name: Capital Allocator Skill
skills_used.explains: Allocates synthetic capital to proof-backed winners.

skills_used.name: Compute Router Skill
skills_used.explains: Routes synthetic compute toward domains with positive eval deltas.

skills_used.name: Energy Leverage Skill
skills_used.explains: Models energy leverage as an infrastructure-readiness signal.

skills_used.name: Proof Pricing Skill
skills_used.explains: Updates artifact price units based on evidence, adoption, and reputation.

skills_used.name: Artifact Reputation Skill
skills_used.explains: Tracks reputation of reusable intelligence artifacts across sovereign domains.

skills_used.name: Credit Assignment Skill
skills_used.explains: Determines whether improvement or failure belongs to goal, plan, skill, policy, eval, context, or routing artifacts.

skills_used.name: Claim Boundary Skill
skills_used.explains: Prevents synthetic proof scaffolds from being mistaken for real-world financial, scientific, or Kardashev achievements.

skills_used.name: Rollback Routing Skill
skills_used.explains: Restores the last safe baseline when a candidate fails eval or sovereignty checks.
